text_data.shortbiography: Danish monarch, he reigned as King from 1912 to 1947 and was the only king of ...
text_data.sourcenotes:
Sy Scholfield quotes Swedish newspaper, ''Sydsvenska Dagbladet'', 29 September 1870, page 2: "Hennes Kongl. Höghet bevistade i måndags taffeln pa Bernstorff hos Konungen och Drottningen, och prinsen gjorde sitt intråde i verlden fyra minuter före midnatt, hvadan han således år född den 26 september." (Translation: The prince entered the world four minutes before midnight, when he was born on 26 September).

Previously this entry had 11:45 PM: Scholfield quoted from Hans Christian Andersen's diary, Sept 1870 [http://oraapp.kb.dk/hca_pub/cv/main/VolDownload.xsql?nnoc=hca_pub&p_VolNo=8]: "Tirsdag 27. ... Inat før 12 blev en Prinds født af Kronprindsessen, hele Byen flaggede i Dag i det smukke Veir." (Tuesday 27th... Last night before 12 a prince was born to the Crown Princess, the whole city celebrated today in the beautiful weather").

From another book, "Rytterkongen: et portræt af Christian 10" by Knud J. V. Jespersen (Gyldendal A/S, 2009), p. 28: "Under året 1870 noterede den altid meddelsomme kabinetssekretær J.P. Trap i sine erindringer: "Natten mellem den 26de og 27de september nedkom Kronprindsessen paa Bernstorff med en lille Prinds..." (During the year 1870 the always communicative Cabinet Secretary J.P. Trap noted in his memoirs: "On the night between the 26th and 27th September the Crown Princess gave birth at Bernstorff to a little prince...").

text_data.shortbiography: Margrave of Brandenburg-Schwedt, member of the House of Hohenzollern, and a ...
text_data.sourcenotes:
Sy Scholfield forwarded news report from "Amsterdamse courant," 1 June 1677, p. 2: "Berlijn den 25 Mey. Gifteren avondt ten 5 uuren is onfe Ceurvorftinne van een jonge Prins verloft."

(Berlin, 25 May: Yesterday in the evening at 5 o'clock our Princess gave birth to a Prince).

The ''Amsterdamse courant'' is from the Netherlands which adopted the Gregorian calendar in 1583, so the dates are presumably from that calendar.

Scholfield quotes from ''The Present State of the Universe, Or an Account of I. The Rise, Birth ... of All the Present Chief Princes of the World'' (Randall Taylor, 1694), p. 25: "Charles, or Christian-Lewis, born at four of the clock in the Afternoon, May 14 or 17. 1677."

The Julian date of 14 May is 24 May in the Gregorian calendar. Two times are given, 4pm and 5pm, so 4:30pm is used.

text_data.shortbiography: Australian city, the state capital of New South Wales and the most populous ...
text_data.sourcenotes: Sy Scholfield quotes from the "Municipal Beginnings" section of the City of Sydney website: "In 1840, Governor Gipps introduced a bill to the Legislative Council to establish municipal institutions in New South Wales. On 20 July 1842, an Act (6 Vic.No 3) was passed 'to declare the town of Sydney to be a city and to incorporate the inhabitants thereof'" [https://web.archive.org/web/20121203034320/http://www.cityofsydney.nsw.gov.au/aboutsydney/documents/history/hs_chos_history_of_council_1001.pdf]. Also, according to the Sydney Morning Herald (21 July 1842), the "Sydney Municipal Corporation Bill" was the last bill of the day passed on 20 July. The NSW Legislative Council Votes and Proceedings (20 July 1842, available at the State Library of NSW) states that the Council met at 12 o'clock that day and adjourned at Four o'Clock. There were six items on the agenda, with the Sydney Corporation Bill being the fourth. A time of 3pm for the passing of that bill is speculative but based on that information.\n

text_data.sourcenotes:
Birth certificate in hand from Sy Scholfield has no time.

Scholfield quotes from ''José Santos Chocano, poeta de América'' by F. Zora Carvajal (Editorial Garcilaso, 1969), p. 21: "En los libros parroquiales del Sagrario de la Catedral, de la ciudad de Lima, existe una partida que dice así: "En la ciudad de Lima, en veintitrés de mayo de mil ochocientos setenticinco, el Presbítero D. Liberato Gutiérrez, ínter de la Parroquia del Sagrario de la Catedral, exorcizó, bautizó solemnemente, puso óleo y crisma a José Santos, nacido el catorce de los corrientes, blanco; hijo legítimo de don José Félix Chocano y de doña María Aurora Gastanodi... Los biógrafos del poeta apuntan que nació en un día lluvioso, a las siete de la noche El, después, afirmaría que nació a las siete y catorce minutos."
(In the parish books of the Sagrario de la Catedral, in the city of Lima, there is a line which reads as follows: 'In the city of Lima, on the twenty-third of May, eighteen hundred and seventy-five, the Presbyter D. Liberato Gutierrez, of the Sagrario Cathedral, exorcized, baptized solemnly, put oil and christened Jose Santos, born the fourteenth of the current month, white, legitimate son of Don Jose Félix Chocano and Dona Maria Aurora Gastanodi...' The poet's biographers point out that he was born on a rainy day at seven o'clock in the evening. He later claimed that he was born at seven-fourteen).

Time is given as morning in ''Obras completas'' by José Santos Chocano and ‎Luis Alberto Sánchez (Aguilar, 1954), p. 13: "José Santos Chocano nació en Lima el 14 de mayo de 1875, a las 7 y 14 minutos de la mañana, de donde arranca su notoria superstición por el número 7 y sus factores 3 y 4." (José Santos Chocano was born in Lima on 14 May 1875, at 7:14 in the morning, from where he began his notorious superstition by number 7 and his factors 3 and 4).

Same data in ''José Santos Chocano: sus últimos años'' by Margarita Aguilar Machado (Arancibia Hnos, 1964), p. 27: "José Santos Chocano nació en Lima, el 14 de mayo de 1875, a las 7 y 14 minutos de la mañana."

Original entry had place of Oakland, California: Craft quotes Cole in an interview saying she was born at 11:11. She made no distinction between AM or PM. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X10g8AKjidI&feature=youtu.be]

On 18-Aug-2017 Sy Scholfield changed place of birth from Oakland to Los Angeles, and confirmed AM time of birth, quoting her on Twitter: "Did u guys kno I was born in LA and raised in Oakland,?" [https://twitter.com/KeyshiaCole/status/452659120571949056], "It is my Bday in the AM..." (posted 7:45pm PDT, 14 Oct 2012) [https://twitter.com/KeyshiaCole/status/257673638235475969], "I was born 11:11" [https://twitter.com/KeyshiaCole/status/886770922379542528]; and full name and place from California Birth Index: "Keyshia Myeshia Johnson, 15 Oct 1981, Los Angeles, Mother's Name: Lons."
On 20-Oct-2018 Scholfield changed time to 11:11 PM, quoting Cole on Twitter/Instagram: "Thank you for ALL YOUR BDAY WISHES!!! OMG !!! I love u all back!!! I was BORN AT 11:11 SOooooooo SEND ME SOME WISHES At that time if you’re still up!!! That’ll really make my night!!!!!!!" (posted 15 Oct 2018) [https://www.instagram.com/p/Bo-PiAEAlrB], [https://twitter.com/KeyshiaCole/status/1051981229829083136].

A speculative time of 7 AM gives mid Sagittarius (17 degrees) rising.

Sy Scholfield quotes from ''Rivoli cenni di storia e statistica'' [Outline of Rivoli history and statistics], Volume 11, by Filiberto Balegno (a spese dell'autore, 1872), pages 65-66: "Intesa che fu la gravidanza di madama la duchessa, le LL. AA. proposero far l'invernata nel Castello di Rivoli, ed alli 12 gennaio del 1562 ed alle ore dodeci dell'orologio italiano, S. D. M. le concesse il felice e desideratissimo parto del serenissimo principe a perpetua conservazione de suoi Stati e tranquillita del cristianesimo..."

(Translation: Aware of the pregnancy of Madame the Duchess, the LL. AA. they proposed to spend winter in the Castello di Rivoli, and on 12 January 1562 at twelve o'clock on the Italian clock, S. D. M. granted her the happy and much desired birth of the most serene prince in perpetual conservation of his States and tranquility of Christianity...).

In December 2023 the following email was received from Hervé Delboy: "Concerning Carlo Emanuele I, the time of birth indicated is Italian time: it is therefore not 12 p.m. but "at the twelfth hour". Because the day began at sunset, and the night lasted 12 hours, this indicates sunrise, which was close to 7:30 in the morning in modern time measurement.

text_data.sourcenotes:
Sy Scholfield downloaded a screenshot of Cox's natal chart shown in an interview between astrologer Chani Nicholas and Cox on YouTube (originally on Netflix) [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u-w-LVg1TGc]. The chart shows planets and Ascendant and MC in the signs (no degrees shown). The Ascendant is in about two-thirds Leo and the MC in mid-Taurus, and Nicholas comments that "the asteroid Terpsichore was in a part of the sky that was rising up as you were born" (in Cox's chart Terpsichore was at 22 Leo), and "the Sun is in the 11th House" (it is unclear which House system Nicholas has used).

At the start of a YouTube video "It Got Better Featuring Laverne Cox", Cox states "I was born and raised in a city called Mobile, Alabama", "I was born seven minutes before my identical twin brother" [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u-w-LVg1TGc].

text_data.shortbiography: French novelist, critic, and playwright from the French Overseas department and ...
text_data.sourcenotes:
A researcher quoted "Tales From The Heart: True Stories of My Childhood" Chapter 2 My Birth: "At 1 in the afternoon...Two hours later I was born."

Sy Scholfield found the full quote: "At one in the afternoon, rushing in from every outlying corner, the mas invaded La Pointe. When the first beats of the gwoka shook the pillars of heaven, as if she were waiting for that very signal, my mother lost her waters. My father, my brothers and sisters, and the servants went into a panic. No cause for alarm. Two hours later, I was born."
The "researcher" gave the year as 1937 but no year is given in ''Tales From The Heart''. Scholfield changed the year to 1934 which is given in various biographical resources.

text_data.sourcenotes:
Date of birth from Wikipedia which states she was born in Madison, Wisconsin. However the place of birth is uncertain. Viktor E. received a 'birth certificate not on file' note from the Wisconsin state vital records office after they searched their statewide indexes for the years 1967-1971.

Sy Scholfield quotes birth notice, ''Casper Star-Tribune'' (Casper, Wyoming), 20 March 1969, page 10, which gives her name as Mary Clare Cheney and states that she was born to her parents residing in Annandale, Virginia, no birth date given. Annandale is part of Fairfax County, VA, which borders both the City of Alexandria and Arlington County and forms part of the suburban ring of Washington, D.C. Her birth notice indicates she was born in this region. Indeed, she writes in her autobiography, "My parents moved to Washington, DC, a few months before I was born" (''Now It's My Turn: A Daughter's Chronicle of Political Life'' by Mary Cheney, Simon and Schuster, 2006).

(Translation: Antonio was the son of Antonio Cortina Roca, originally from Meliana, and María Farinós Capilla, from Almàssera! Four . Born in the family home, located on Calle del Rey's, in Almàssera, at twelve noon on 16 February 1841, he was baptized the next day in the parish church of his hometown.)

El niño había nacido a la una de la tarde del día 9 de aquel mismo mes , en la casa número 1 de la calle de Espartero , domicilio del matrimonio Catalán - Sañudo ."

(Translation: On 12 October 1894 at a quarter past nine in the morning, Miguel Sañudo Fernández appeared at the offices of the Zaragoza Civil Registry, expressing his desire to register a child from the marriage of his sister María with the teacher from the General and Technical Institute of the city, Mr. Agustín Catalán Latorre. The child was born at one o'clock in the afternoon of the 9th of that same month at house number 1 on Espartero street, domicile of the Catalan-Sañudo couple.)

text_data.shortbiography: Catalan nationalist politician who served as general secretary of the Estat ...
text_data.sourcenotes:
Sy Scholfield quotes from the biography ''Joan Cornudella i Barberà (1904-1985): biografia política : 50 anys d'independentisme català'' by Fermí Rubiralta i Casas (L'Abadia de Montserrat, 2003), page 11: 

"Joan Cornudella i Barberà va néixer a les set del vespre del dia tres de novembre de 1904 , al número 65 , avui 69 , del car- rer de la Font del municipi de les Borges Blanques , cap de la comarca de les Garrigues , segons consta en el Registre Civil del seu poble."

Translation: Joan Cornudella i Barberà was born at seven in the evening on the third of November 1904 at number 65, today 69, of Carrer de la Font in the municipality of les Borges Blanques, capital of the county of les Garrigues, according to records in the Civil Registry of the town.

Source given as "Seccio de naixements del Registre Civil de l'Ajuntament de les Borges Blanques , tom 12 , foli 103 ."
(Births section of the Civil Registry of the Borges Blanques Town Hall, tome 12, folio 103.).

text_data.sourcenotes:
Sy Scholfield quotes from his website:
"Sono nato alle ore 20.10 del 25 dicembre e pesavo - cosa che mia mamma novantenne ormai ricorda ad ogni visita medica a cui la porto al povero dottore che la visita - due chili e tre etti. Dovevo nascere nel 1959 ed invece sono nato l'anno prima, il giorno di Natale. Mia mamma venne accompagnata alla Maternità di Aosta (la mia generazione cominciava a nascere così e non più in casa con l'ostetrica) da mio papà, che fu autorizzato ad assistere al parto perché... veterinario." [https://caveri.it/blog/2019/12/27/pensieri-natalizi-di-chi-compie-gli-anni].

Translation: I was born at 8.10 PM on 25 December and I weighed - something that my ninety-year-old mother now remembers at every medical visit I take her to the poor doctor who visits her - two kilos and three ounces. I should have been born in 1959 and instead I was born the year before, on Christmas Day. My mother was accompanied to the Aosta maternity hospital (my generation was starting to be born like this and no longer at home with the midwife) by my father, who was authorized to attend the birth because... [he was] a vet.

text_data.shortbiography: Argentine human rights activist and president of the association of ...
text_data.sourcenotes:
Francisco Robledo cites a Facebook post by astrologer Carolina Goldsman, dated 22 October 2020, in which she provides a picture of herself with Carlotto above Carlotto's natal chart, and writes:
"Esta mujer cumple hoy 90 años. 
Estela de Carlotto es una líder, creadora y activista argentina para la vigencia efectiva de los Derechos Humanos. Presidenta de la asociación Abuelas de Plaza de Mayo.
Esta es una foto durante el paseo que hicimos por La Barra y Jose Ignacio en 2007, cuando la invite a participar del Festival de Cine en el que trabajaba.
Yo recién había renunciado al mundo de la Abogacía y me había venido a vivir a Uruguay.
Su presencia me dio fuerza para crear el gran cambio en mi vida, animarme a saltar y soltar, y ver que los Derechos Humanos no solamente se trabajan en el mundo del "Derecho".
Estela de Carlotto, gran persona, feliz cumpleaños!!!"
--------------------------------
(Translation: This woman is 90 years old today. Estela de Carlotto is an Argentinian leader, creator and activist for the effective validity of Human Rights. President of the association Grandmothers of Plaza de Mayo. This is a photo during the walk we did through La Barra and Jose Ignacio in 2007, when I invited her to participate in the Film Festival where I worked. I had just given up on the world of Law and had come to live in Uruguay. Her presence gave me strength to create the great change in my life, encourage me to jump and let go, and see that Human Rights are not only worked in the world of "Law". Estela de Carlotto, great person, happy birthday!!!).

We assume then that the time of birth came from Carlotto in person.

Sy Scholfield quotes him on his website:
"Ebbene sì, oggi è il mio genetliaco. Nato il 2 luglio 1965, ho la piena consapevolezza che il tempo effettivamente scorra senza sosta. Sono 48 anni tondi tondi. Per farmi un regalo da condividere con voi, vi riporto di seguito i 48 modi per dire olio di oliva in diverse lingue, compreso il dialetto del mio paese natale.... ''egghiu'' – dialetto di San Pietro in Lama, comune alle porte di Lecce dove sono nato alle ore 4 del mattino, in una giornata di grande afa." [https://www.olioofficina.it/magazine/culture/olivo-matto/quarantotto-modi-per-dire-olio-di-oliva.htm].
-----------------
Translation: Well yes, today is my birthday. Born on 2 July 1965, I am fully aware that time actually passes without stopping. That's 48 years straight. To give myself a gift to share with you, below are the 48 ways to say olive oil in different languages, including the dialect of my hometown.... ''egghiu'' – dialect of San Pietro in Lama, a municipality just outside Lecce where I was born at 4 in the morning, on a very sultry day.

"A tono con la dinámica de la astrología y los horóscopos, Charlotte reveló que es el del signo de Acuario. "Acuario, con ascendente en Géminis y Luna en Sagitario. Es ella y sus circunstancias. It's her and her circumstances. They don't grab Charlotte, but not even a little bit. Very free, I don't care about anything, but literally nothing," the astrologer explained. To which she admitted: "It's true, I'm very difficult to marry."
--------------------------------

text_data.shortbiography: Argentine pop-rock singer-songwriter, guitarist and actress who has sold more ...
text_data.sourcenotes:
Sy Scholfield quotes her in an online magazine interview and profile: 
–¿Y en vos de dónde surgió ese espíritu celta?

–Te cuento la historia: se llama Cuna de piedra porque a mí me encantan la astrología, la metafísica y todo lo esotérico. Y yo, que soy Piscis ascendente en Escorpio y tengo luna en Capricornio, cuando googleé por qué ésa era mi luna, encontré “Cuna de piedra” con la foto de una mujer rubia, con unos cuernos de árbol re celtas. Este hallazgo me potenció una idea que yo ya tenía. Es que mi tátara-tátara-tátara abuela, Rita Dogan, casada con Juan Martín de Pueyrredón, el padre del que fue director supremo, era una maga blanca irlandesa y se decía que la séptima generación, que vengo a ser yo, iba a heredar sus poderes. No sé si los heredé o no, pero me mantienen viva.

("Fabiana Cantilo: “Heredé los poderes de una antepasada maga blanca irlandesa”," Gente, 31 August 2019 [https://www.revistagente.com/entretenimiento/celebrities/fabiana-cantilo-segun-una-leyenda-herede-los-poderes-de-una-antepasada-maga-blanca-irlandesa/]).
------------------------
Translation: 
–And where did that Celtic spirit come from in you?
–I'll tell you the story: it's called Stone Cradle because I love astrology, metaphysics and everything esoteric. And I, who am a Pisces, rising in Scorpio and have a moon in Capricorn, when I Googled why that was my moon, I found “Stone Cradle” with a photo of a blonde woman, with some Celtic tree horns. This discovery strengthened an idea that I already had. The thing is that my great-great-great grandmother, Rita Dogan, married to Juan Martín de Pueyrredón, the father of whom he was supreme director, was a white Irish magician and it was said that the seventh generation, which is me, was going to inherit his powers. I don't know if I inherited them or not, but they keep me alive.
-----------------------------
Scorpio was rising from about 9:30 PM to 11 PM.

text_data.sourcenotes:
Sy Scholfield quotes a media profile, "ASTRO PROFILE: ALVON COLLISON (Taurus: April 25, 1941)" by Sandy Maxwell, ''Weekend Argus'', 21 April 2007, page 10:
"Alvon “The Entertainer” Collison has done it all – cabaret, revue, stage and television – also birthday shows and company functions. He has a Three Leaf Award and a Gallo Award for his performance in Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat. He recently hosted a special birthday at GrandWest for one of his keenest fans – she turned 100. Nowadays he is also busy finding, nurturing and promoting new talent. Collison, a Sun Taurus with Moon in Aries, was born on the cusp of Scorpio and Sagittarius Rising – and is accordingly practical and purposeful, is cheerful and quick-witted and delights in giving pleasure to all. His emotions are generally positive and upbeat, yet with that Scorpio strain peeking through, he also has his fears and suspicions. Mainly, Alvon exudes expansive optimism – his enthusiasm and passion for life is contagious. Having motivating Mars in Aquarius, he needs the freedom to follow his own path and harbours some off-beat and unique traits. Mercury (reasoning and expression) in Aries renders him honest and outspoken as well as gregarious and witty. Sun alongside Venus, Jupiter, Saturn and Uranus in Taurus augur well for a successful artistic and musical career, and also instil cooking and gardening skills and a need for material security. He has a great sense of form, rhythm and colour – all apparent in his delightful performances and original costumes. Let Alvon bring some magic to your function. Call 021 551 0969."
A birth time of 7:30 PM is speculative.

text_data.shortbiography: Brazilian writer, musician, educator, poet and photographer. He studied ...
text_data.sourcenotes:
Sy Scholfield quotes him on Instagram: "nasci dia trinta e um de janeiro. às onze da noite. cheguei atrasado no dia do meu nascimento e quase nasci um dia depois. como castigo, o universo me entregou um ascendente em escorpião.

desde então, brigam entre si um ascendente que me colocou em situações adversas por seus impulsos, uma lua sagitariana que se aproveita desses impulsos para viajar, alguns planetas em capricórnio que negociam a todo momento os gastos dessas viagens, além do sol em aquário, uma luz cética, que não crê em signos e fala muito sobre eles, inconformado com o mundo e com que as pessoas dele.

mais de três décadas se passaram e ainda não aprendi a sair com os olhos abertos em uma foto, diferente de quando nasci, com los ojos bien abiertos, igual que aureliano buendía." [https://www.instagram.com/gtrdaniel/p/DFgUdLwvhVI/].
Translation: I was born on the thirty-first of January. at eleven at night. I arrived late on my birth day and was almost born a day later. As punishment, the universe gave me a Scorpio ascendant.

Since then, an ascendant who put me in adverse situations due to his impulses has been fighting with each other, a Sagittarius moon that takes advantage of these impulses to travel, some planets in Capricorn that constantly negotiate the costs of these trips, in addition to the sun in Aquarius, a skeptical light, which does not believe in signs and talks a lot about them, unhappy with the world and the people in it.

More than three decades have passed and I still haven't learned how to look with my eyes open in a photo, unlike when I was born, with my eyes wide open, just like Aureliano Buendía.

text_data.shortbiography: Brazilian language teacher, author, public speaker and internet personality, ...
text_data.sourcenotes:
Sy Scholfield quotes her on Instagram in a birthday post (16 October 2018): "Libriana, com ascendente em Áries e com forte influência de capricórnio." (Libra, with Aries ascendant and strong Capricorn influence.) [https://www.instagram.com/cintiachagass/p/Bo_ozNxBgHn/?hl=en].
--------------------
News media reported on her birthday in early October 2024: "Prestes a completar 42 anos, a influenciadora digital Cíntia Chagas usou as redes sociais para compartilhar uma reflexão sobre seu aniversário. Em um vídeo compartilhado nos stories do Instagram, ela fez uma retrospectiva sobre várias fases da sua vida.

“Dia 16 de outubro, eu Cíntia Chagas, maravilhosa, farei 42 anos. Exatamente, completarei 42 primaveras”, iniciou ela. “Será o meu aniversário e eu comecei a refletir acerca dos motivos que me trouxeram até aqui, como vocês sabem eu estou no Instagram há 10 anos. E eu percebi o seguinte, não adianta ter conhecimento técnico quando não se tem outros tipos de conhecimento”, complementou Cíntia." [https://caras.com.br/atualidades/prestes-completar-42-anos-cintia-chagas-compartilha-reflexao-comecei.phtml#google_vignette], [https://www.instagram.com/noticias_luanda/reel/DA8yf6GNG00/].

(Translation: About to turn 42, digital influencer Cíntia Chagas used social media to share a reflection on her birthday. In a video shared on Instagram, she looked back at various stages of her life.
“On 16 October, I, Cíntia Chagas, wonderful, will be 42 years old. Exactly, I will complete 42 springs”, she began. “It will be my birthday and I started to reflect on the reasons that brought me here, as you know I have been on Instagram for 10 years. And I realized the following: there is no point in having technical knowledge when you don’t have other types of knowledge”, added Cíntia.)
------------
Aries was rising (with Capricorn on the MC) from about 4:20 PM to about 6:20 PM. A speculative birth time of 6 PM puts Saturn (which is conjunct her Sun, Moon, Venus and Pluto) on the Descendant.

Rowan Williams sent the link to a newspaper article in which a clipping of Mark Carney’s birth notice is reproduced along with a transcript: 
"Carney’s birthday is on Sunday. His birth – on March 16, 1965 – was marked in an edition of The Norther, a short-lived daily newspaper based in his hometown of Fort Smith, NWT. “Bob Carney and his wife, Verlie, welcomed an 8 lb 11 oz son, Mark Joseph who arrived at St Ann’s this morning at 7:56. Mark arrived in the best of health to make a fine new brother for Sean & Brenda.”
("Read the NWT newspaper that carried Mark Carney’s birth notice," by Ollie Williams, ''Cabin Radio'', Yellowknife, NT, 14 March 2025 [https://cabinradio.ca/227753/news/politics/read-the-nwt-newspaper-that-carried-mark-carneys-birth-notice/]). Copy of clipping on file.

text_data.shortbiography: American football linebacker, nicknamed "Bam," who plays for the Boston College ...
text_data.sourcenotes:
Sy Scholfield quotes from an online news profile:
"When Crouch was born, on April 3, 2004, his mother’s sister was also pregnant and due to deliver her baby around the same timeframe.
On Thursday morning at 2025 ACC Football Kickoff, Crouch finally revealed the true origin of his nickname. It had to do with the fact that Masha Watts, Crouch’s mother, and her sister didn’t want to have a baby on the same day.
So, as grotesque as it might sound, Crouch had to “Bam” his way out of the womb before his cousin arrived, a day later.

“Yeah, my mom gave [my nickname] to me when I was born,” Crouch said. “So my cousin was born April 4, and I was born April 3. But I was born at like 11:30 p.m. and my auntie told my mom, ‘You better not have your baby the same day as my babies’ birthday.’ So I’m all of a sudden ‘bamming’ my way out of here. My mom always say I ‘bammed’ out of there.”"
("Boston College LB Daveon 'Bam' Crouch Wasn't Nicknamed in the Most Ordinary Manner, But it Sticks," Boston College, 24 July 2025 [https://www.si.com/college/bostoncollege/football/boston-college-linebacker-daveon-bam-crouch-nickname-acc-kickoff-2025]).
Place of birth is unconfirmed.
